Title: Relates to the election to participate in the federal education tax credit program; relates to the powers of the commissioner of taxation and finance
Summary: Clarifies that the board of regents is the sole entity responsible for electing to have the state participate in the federal qualified elementary and secondary education scholarships program pursuant to 26 U.S.C. Section 25F and that the board of regents is the sole entity to determine what entities are qualified scholarship granting organizations; prohibits the commissioner of taxation and finance from electing, or taking any action to implement an election or participate in the federal scholarship tax credit program established under 26 U.S.C. Section 25F unless the board of regents has elected on behalf of the state to participate in such program.
LawCode: Add §101-c, Ed L; amd §171, Tax L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to the election to participate in the federal education tax credit program; and to amend the tax law, in relation to the powers of the commissioner of taxation and finance
